name: Discord invite resolver (public API, keyless)
tier_rationale: Discord Inc.: an established company with published developer terms, a privacy policy and a documented public API (A8 trusted). Council P101 cond 1: registry provider discord, tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for the invite it resolves (guild id, counts, expiry, inviter); guild names and descriptions are written by the server owner (attacker-controlled when the server is hostile).

invites.title: Discord invite resolver GET /api/v10/invites/{code}?with_counts=true&with_expiration=true (keyless, read-only)

terms.quote: Registry provider discord: tier trusted, terms open; invites are PERSONAL_TYPES (P333), so personal_data_review comes before default use (A3 BR8).

invites.notes: Quote: binding council text (P101 cond 1); research C0233 (verified_live 200). GET only, keyless: never POST (join/accept), never a bot or user token, never a webhook URL (P101 cond 1/5). 404 {'code':10006,'message':'Unknown Invite'} = invalid or expired invite (never 'no such server'); 429 honours the JSON retry_after (one retry within 15 s, else RATE_LIMITED, P101 cond 3). Discord global limits apply and no X-RateLimit headers were seen on this route (2026-11-26): min_interval 2 s, concurrency 1, no quota block. discord.gg and discordapp.com URLs are parsed locally and never fetched.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G05-1 (module discord_invite, P101). personal_data_review is still to be recorded (discord_invite is a PERSONAL_TYPES value, A3 BR8). Cache: valid invites 6 h (counts and expiry change), Unknown Invite answers 24 h.
